Assessment Services
Assessment Services Information. More details and contact information about each township, city and village can be found below. Click to view a printable list of the Hillsdale County Assessors .
Each year a Board of Review is conducted in March for the purpose of receiving and reviewing assessment rolls and hearing property tax assessment appeals from property owners. Click here to view dates, times and locations of each Board of Review in Hillsdale County .
